profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Azure High Performance Compute

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer Manager
positions.description:
Led AI services initiatives focused on building, scaling, and operationalizing intelligent solutions across the organization, including growth of the business in air-gapped cloud environments. I was responsible for managing AI service delivery, coordinating cross-functional teams, overseeing platform capabilities, and ensuring solutions aligned with business goals, security requirements, and customer needs.
In this role, I drove strategy and execution for AI-powered services, supported adoption of emerging AI technologies, expanded AI services in secure and disconnected cloud environments, managed stakeholder expectations, and helped translate complex technical capabilities into practical business outcomes. I was also accountable for service reliability, roadmap planning, team coordination, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported Azure Cognitive Services teams, including Translator, Speech, and related AI services, by helping improve service buildout, deployment, and operational readiness. Partnered with engineering teams to onboard them onto scalable deployment tooling and streamline how services were delivered across cloud environments.
Led technical efforts around a Rust-based buildout and deployment tool, helping teams adopt reliable automation for service provisioning, rollout, and lifecycle management. Worked across teams to improve engineering efficiency, reduce deployment complexity, and enable faster, more consistent delivery of Cognitive Services capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported the buildout and deployment of AI services in air-gapped cloud environments, including AI Container Platform, Speech Services, Microsoft Translator, and related Cognitive Services capabilities. Partnered with engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable service infrastructure for disconnected and highly regulated cloud environments.
Contributed to platform readiness, deployment automation, service integration, and operational improvements that enabled AI services to run consistently across specialized cloud environments. Helped improve deployment reliability, reduce buildout complexity, and support the expansion of enterprise AI capabilities in secure cloud scenarios.
